# AI wireframe tool that generates production-ready UI designs in seconds

dxmax is an AI wireframe tool that turns a one-line prompt into a complete wireframe, mockup, or UI design — production-ready HTML and CSS, not a static mockup. Describe what you need ("a SaaS pricing page with three tiers, dark theme, social proof above the fold") and dxmax generates the layout, copy, design system, and components in seconds. You iterate by chat — "make the hero darker," "add a logo strip" — until it matches what you wanted.

Built for the 90% of teams who do not have a senior designer in the room: founders sketching their first SaaS dashboard, product managers scoping a feature for engineering, AI coders who need a visual blueprint before Cursor or Claude Code generates the implementation, agencies who need to ship a client landing page this week. The output is real HTML you can hand to a developer, edit yourself, or ship as-is via the built-in deploy.

Free tier: 1 prompt every 24 hours, unlimited iteration on existing pages. Pro: 100 prompts per day, 20 pages per project, version history, team workspaces, branded deployment. No credit card required to start; try a prompt and see whether the output matches what you would have built.
